materials.name: W-0505ED-N4
materials.resin: Thermoplastic polyimide film, adhesiveless double sided
materials.notes: Polyimide 0.5 mil, copper 1/2 oz ED on both sides (Nanya foil); thickness tolerance 49 +/- 10 um. The values on the sheet are published with a greater-or-equal sign (peel strength 0.6 kgf/cm, volume resistance 1.0E+12 ohm cm, surface resistance 1.0E+11 ohm, insulation resistance 1.0E+9 ohm, tensile strength 20 kg/mm2, elongation 25 %, tensile modulus 550 kg/mm2, MIT folding 800 cycles) and are not stored. CTE 24 ppm/C and Tg 350 C are by the maker's own method (not stored as a Tg). Dielectric strength 5.5 kV/mil (converted). Dimensional stability -0.1 to -0.1 % (MD and TD); solder float 30 s at 288 C passes. Sheet 250 or 500 mm wide, 400-700 mm long; roll 100 m.
